Notes on keeping a notebook

A notebook is the cheapest tool for thinking that anyone has invented, and it keeps working long after the novelty of a new app has worn off. Here is what has stuck for me after a decade.

Start with a rule

The only rule I never break is to date every page. Everything else bends, but the date lets me find things later, and it turns the notebook into a record instead of a pile.

  1. Write the date at the top of every page before anything else.
  2. Leave the left margin empty so you can annotate later.
  3. Review the last week's pages every Sunday evening.

That is all there is to it, honestly, and the simplicity is exactly why it lasts.
